events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Album Impact
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed everything. What's your top track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years since the iconic event
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, a generation gathered for peace, music, and three days that changed history. What's your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled legacy of Elvis Presley. His music continues to move generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact and lyrical genius of Tupac Shakur, gone too soon. His words still resonate today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, the visionary who redefined the electric guitar. His sound lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years of 'Abbey Road'! That zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. What's your favourite song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend with a voice that commands attention.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single: 51 years
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' offered a vision of peace. Its message remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, changing how we listened to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?
